ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PERIOD_SUMMARY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_period_summary (p_start_date in date,p_end_date in date) IS
 curdate date := p_start_date ;
 total_staff number := 0 ;
 found number(5) := 0;
BEGIN
 message('Working...',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE);
 --pitss synchronize ;
 if p_start_date is null or p_end_date is null then 
 return ;
 end if ;
 go_block('PERIOD_SUMMARY') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 clear_block ;
 loop
 :summary_date := curdate ;
 :summary_day := to_char(curdate,'DY') ;
 begin
 select count(*) into :drive_count
 from drives
 where drive_date = curdate
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM' ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 
 begin
 select nvl(sum(number_reqd),0) into :est_staff
 from drive_estimated_resources
 where drive_id in ( select drive_id from drives
 where drive_date = curdate
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM')
 and resource_code = 'STAFF'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 
 begin
 select count(*) into total_staff
 from employees
 where emp_class = 'MSTAF'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 
 begin
 select count(*) into :unavl_staff
 from staff_off_day
 where unavail_date = curdate 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 
 :res_level := 0 ;
 begin
 select nvl(available_number,0) into :res_level
 from resource_exceptions
 where resource_code = 'STAFF'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_date = curdate ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select nvl(max_available,0) into :res_level
 from resource_avail_rules
 where resource_code = 'STAFF'
 and week_day = to_char(curdate,'DY')
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 
 :avl_staff := total_staff - :unavl_staff ;
 next_record ;
 curdate := curdate + 1 ;
 if curdate > p_end_date then
 exit ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 clear_message ;
 first_record ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_FROM_DATE','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_TO_DATE','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_REASON_CODE','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_FACILITY_CODE','D') ;
 set_item_property('PB_RETRIEVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('PB_REASON',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('PB_FACLT',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
END;
